text:
The biggest issue is customer support. There is no proper option to directly connect with a human representative. Customers are forced to interact with an AI chatbot for several minutes before getting the option to speak with a person, which is frustrating and wastes valuable time.

The complaint management system is also disappointing. Once a complaint is created, there is no clear status tracking or transparency regarding its progress.

The refund amount was credited to me, but after I informed FirstCry about the mistake, they asked me to return the correct product. After the correct product was picked up, they denied receiving it and refused to process the refund, claiming I had not handed over the item.

Despite multiple calls and follow-ups, I received no resolution. Only after filing a complaint with the consumer forum did FirstCry contact me and finally refund the amount—almost a month later. When I asked why the issue was suddenly resolved, I was told it was because I had raised a consumer complaint.

Another frustrating change is that refunds are now often credited to the FirstCry wallet instead of the original payment source, reducing customer flexibility.

Additionally, the app frequently hangs and has performance issues, making the overall shopping experience even worse.

As a long-time customer, I expected much better service and accountability.
